article_title: To joke or not to joke?: How to write a good out-of-office message

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main advice about out-of-office messages?
options: Make them clear, concise and useful, while choosing humour carefully
Include a long description of every holiday activity
Avoid giving a return date or alternative contact
Use the same informal joke for every audience
tasks.correct_answer: Make them clear, concise and useful, while choosing humour carefully
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה ממליצה על הודעה ברורה, קצרה ושימושית, ומזהירה שהומור צריך להתאים לקהל ולהקשר.

tasks.prompt: Which information does etiquette guidance say an automatic reply should include?
options: The sender's holiday photographs
A specific return date and, when appropriate, an alternative contact
A list of the sender's hobbies
A promise to answer every email immediately on returning
tasks.correct_answer: A specific return date and, when appropriate, an alternative contact
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הודעה טובה מציינת מועד חזרה ברור ומפנה לגורם חלופי כאשר הדבר מתאים.

tasks.prompt: What does “concise” mean in the advice to employees?
options: Sarcastic and entertaining
Written without a greeting
Brief but containing the necessary information
Updated only once a year
tasks.correct_answer: Brief but containing the necessary information
tasks.explanation_hebrew: concise פירושו תמציתי: קצר, אך עדיין כולל את המידע שהנמען צריך.

tasks.prompt: Why can a sarcastic joke be risky in an automatic reply?
options: Automatic replies cannot display punctuation
Sarcasm is required only for urgent messages
It makes the return date technically invalid
Recipients from different workplaces or cultures may misunderstand the tone
tasks.correct_answer: Recipients from different workplaces or cultures may misunderstand the tone
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הודעה אוטומטית מגיעה לקהלים שונים, ולכן סרקזם עלול לא להיות מובן או להיתפס כלא מקצועי.

tasks.prompt: What should an employee avoid when explaining a holiday absence?
options: Giving a useful contact name
Oversharing personal details or boasting about the trip
Thanking the recipient for the email
Checking that the return date is correct
tasks.correct_answer: Oversharing personal details or boasting about the trip
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה ממליצה להימנע משיתוף יתר ומרברבנות, שעלולים להישמע לא מקצועיים או זחוחים.

tasks.prompt: What is an email “backlog” in the context of returning to work?
options: A friendly greeting at the start of a message
A scheduled briefing before a holiday
A build-up of unanswered messages waiting to be dealt with
A stale joke copied into an automatic reply
tasks.correct_answer: A build-up of unanswered messages waiting to be dealt with
tasks.explanation_hebrew: backlog הוא הצטברות של הודעות ומשימות שטרם טופלו בזמן ההיעדרות.

tasks.prompt: List four pieces of practical information that can make an out-of-office reply useful.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ארבעה פרטים מעשיים שהנמען יכול לפעול לפיהם.
expected_points: A polite greeting
The period of absence
A specific return date
Whether email will be checked periodically
A named alternative contact or help desk
Instructions for genuinely urgent matters

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's advice on content, tone, humour and expectations in an out-of-office message.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול מידע הכרחי, סגנון, סיכוני הומור ותיאום ציפיות.
expected_points: The message should be polite and concise
It should state when the employee will return
Urgent senders should be directed to an available alternative contact
Personal detail, boasting and oversharing should be avoided
Humour depends on the audience and sarcasm can be misunderstood
The message should not promise an immediate response if a backlog is likely

tasks.prompt: Why is under-communication sometimes more damaging than an unsuccessful joke?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד היעדר מידע מעשי יוצר אי־ודאות ופוגע ביכולת הנמען לפעול.
expected_points: The sender may not know when a reply will arrive
An urgent matter may have no clear alternative route
Colleagues or clients cannot plan around the absence
Uncertainty can make the employee appear disorganised
A clear factual message remains useful even without humour

tasks.prompt: Write the content plan for a professional out-of-office message for a one-week holiday. Explain whether you would include a joke and why.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע מבנה הודעה מקצועי ולהצדיק את בחירת הטון בהתאם לקהל.
expected_points: Begin with a polite greeting or thanks
State the absence and exact return date
Set a realistic expectation about email access and response time
Provide an approved alternative contact for urgent work
Avoid unnecessary holiday details and boasting
Use humour only if it fits the organisation and broad audience
Check that names, dates and contact details are current
